author: Noneknowme
title: Fun but definitely a Money Grab
content:
Money grab game. They make even the easy levels increasingly difficult on the treasure hunt once you get around Level 14/15 to dissuade you from playing to higher levels. They really don’t want you to win those 10,000 coins. 

I’ve notice the longer I play and get closer to it, the levels becoming increasingly difficult. It’s almost like they don’t want you to play??? You can play for about an hour, hour and a half a day before they give these 1.5 minute rounds that have a plethora of bombs make the difficulty very hard and yet there’s no warning it’s a hard level, let alone a super hard level. 

I also noticed that after I paid to get rid of ads, I have less playing time with normal rounds. I get maybe 45 minutes before they give the 1.5 minute rounds that are supposed to be won by “strategy” even though the hole isn’t fast enough to cover the board in that time. There’s no strategy when you can’t even cover the board. 

Don’t pay to get rid of ads! You just get less playing time.

Also, please explain how I had 808 coins won 1,000 and my total was less than 1,600??? How is that mathing?

Hard and super hard are thus requiring pay to play or an excessive number of attempts. 

Detailed feedback has been provided over months to the enthusiastic reaction of the customer facing team, but every single flaw still exists, and they will tell you that their developers can solve first time every time so the implied result is that you aren't good enough. Of course they will deny that assumption, but the end result is still pay or give up.

I finally bailed because I'm not giving that kind of development team arrogance a damn dime.

author: Southern3333
title: If you don’t spend money, you don’t get much of a chance…
content:
I am all for a challenge, but I noticed several gameplay issues that make this feel less like a skill-based puzzle game and more like a setup to push in-app purchases.

The game starts out fun, but after a few rounds, progression becomes frustrating fast. Once the harder levels begin, there is a noticeable lag in how quickly the hole moves, especially when trying to collect the required target items. This happened even on a reliable high-speed internet connection, and sometimes the lag did not go away.

The game also seems to rely heavily on boosters, such as the compass, because items are often hidden or nearly impossible to locate within the time limit. In the last round I played before deleting the app, I used a compass to find the final item. It showed where the item should have been, but the item was not there.

Overall, it feels like the game stacks multiple things against the player: movement lag, hidden items, difficult-to-clear levels, and pressure to buy boosters just to keep playing. You can end up replaying the same level over and over until you finally win, and it feels more like luck than actual progression.

The concept is fun, but the gameplay design makes it feel intentionally frustrating unless you are willing to keep spending money. That ruined it for me.

author: victoriamelillo
title: WAS a great way to decompress☹️
content:
I’ve been with this game from within weeks of its release and so much has changed. We’ve traded not amazing but very decent graphics for a greedy program that adapts endlessly, to deplete resources and get more money from the player. Spend money on boosters like a magnet and enlarged sink hole, only to have it jam with items, no matter how many or their size, every single time. Random items will jump away when trying to scoop them up and when using the new feature “Black Hole”, somehow the bombs are attracted and mysteriously jump towards the hole. Some items begin to move as if made of rubber and some just don’t seem to be able to fall in if you’re doing too well. The “bonus” coin level is impossible to achieve more than just over 500 coins. There simply isn’t enough time to gather enough, to ever get the large chest. So it’s nice to be able to pick up a few coins in a level where there are no bombs but there is no chance of getting anything that you notice in your total amount. At the most possible amounts gathered, it is not even half as much as is needed to buy any booster and there is no way of knowing if and when you ever get this random level. Whenever I buy a coin package, there are suddenly the most ridiculously difficult levels and so much noticeable glitchy behavior to the game, that gives the advantage to the game, not the player. It’s all very subtle as I’m sure the program has been updated so that it is geared to make as much money for the company as possible. There are many little things happening so the once challenging but relaxing game has become a stressful experience that feels like being cheated and ripped
off without end.  I’m deleting this game that I’ve been playing for literally years now because it’s lost its appeal as a way to decompress. I’m sure there’s a demographic that will be fine with this game as it is now but there are other games just like this that have not reached this level of absurd difficulty, et~greed.  If you’re ok with feeling cheated at every turn paying constantly, at an average of 10$ per hour of play, then this game is for you.
